carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal carina is visible along the upper-lateral flank, extending towards the caudal peduncle, characterized by a distinct contrast boundary between the illuminated dorsal surface and the shadowed ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a low-density arrangement of small, high-luminance circular spots, primarily localized on the trailing half of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular notch and loss of tissue is visible at the distal tip of the lower lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A small commensal fish is present near the ventral-posterior flank, visible as a dark fusiform silhouette against the water column.
